items.t: Said on her website that she focuses on legislation for families and children, including early education, women's healthcare and child advocacy.
items.q: focuses on legislation that will improve conditions in South Dakota for families and children and is especially interested in work surrounding early education, women’s healthcare, and child advocacy," according to her website.

items.t: Was against a Republican-led bill that would allow ballot initiative signers to remove their signatures.
items.q: They oppose a Republican-led bill that would allow ballot initiative signers to remove their signatures.

items.t: Said that the belief that the safest place for kids is in families with a married mom and dad is dangerous and un-American.
items.q: Extremist group Family Heritage Alliance said this morning that the safest place for kids are in families that have a married mom and dad," Healy tweeted. "What a dangerous and un-American belief.

items.t: Said she was disappointed a simple, important bill could not pass.
items.q: I am disgusted by the extremist opposition we heard today and disappointed we couldn't pass such a simple, important bill," Healy tweeted.
